end.summary: Health was practised as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of illness; this still needs checking for steadiness.
end.parentNote: Siya practised connecting sleep, food, activity, sharing worries and time with friends to physical, mental and social health. They used examples such as sleep, football and sharing worries; planning breakfast and an earlier bedtime was also practised, with the effects still needing further checking. The mix-up that not being sick automatically means being healthy appeared again and was not marked corrected after its last appearance. At home, ask Siya to sort one daily habit into the three health areas and name one small routine change.

Ab sochiye, exam se pehle ek hafte roz sirf paanch ghante sone par padha hua zyada yaad rahega ya kam, aur kyun?
pata nahi… mujhe nahi aata yeh

Koi baat nahi, isko chhota karte hain. Neend ke baad dimaag ko aaram milta hai; kam neend mein subah dhyaan lagana mushkil ho sakta hai. Agar dhyaan kam lage, padha hua yaad karna aasaan hoga ya mushkil?
kam... agar neend poori nahi hogi to dimaag thaka-thaka sa lagega, to padha hua bhi dhyaan se yaad nahi hoga.

Haan, poori neend na ho toh dimaag thaka lag sakta hai aur padha hua yaad rakhna mushkil ho sakta hai. Ab usi exam wali baat par aaiye: ek hafte tak roz sirf paanch ghante sone se padha hua zyada yaad rahega ya kam, aur kyun?
haan... ab bhi nahi pata. yaad rehna mushkil hoga... shayad?

Kyunki paanch ghante ki neend se dimaag ko poora aaram nahi milta, padhte waqt dhyaan lagana aur padha hua yaad rakhna mushkil ho sakta hai. Ab ek naya case sochiye: Meena phone scroll karne ke bajay dost ke saath roz walk karti hai; uski health ke kaunse hisse badal sakte hain, aur kyun?
body toh theek ho sakti hai walk se, lekin Meena toh already healthy hai na... usko koi fever-wager nahi hai, toh kaunsa health change hoga?

Aap keh rahe hain, fever nahi hai toh health mein kya badlega. Sochiye, bina fever ke bhi Meena walk se zyada active ho sakti hai aur dost se baat karke mann halka mehsoos kar sakti hai. Toh bimaar na hone ke alawa health ke kaunse do hisse badal sakte hain?
arey, Meena ko toh fever nahi hai na? toh woh already healthy hai. walk se bas body thodi active ho jaayegi... bas itna hi.

Aap keh rahe hain fever nahi, toh Meena already healthy hai; walk se bas body active hogi. Par sochiye: kisi ko fever na ho, phir bhi woh akela aur pareshaan mehsoos kare, toh kya uski health ka har hissa theek hoga?
teeno... physical, mental, social sab theek ho sakte hain, pata nahi kaise par haan, walk aur dost ke saath time se aisa hota hai.

Haan, teeno par asar ho sakta hai: walk se body active hoti hai, aur dost ke saath waqt se mann aur rishton ko sahara mil sakta hai. Ab Rohan ka case sochiye: woh bimaar nahi hai, phir bhi poori tarah swasth kyun nahi ho sakta?

arey haan... health ka matlab sirf fever na hona nahi hai na. mental aur social bhi health mein aate hain. jaise agar neend kam ho, ya pareshaani ho, ya dost na milen, toh body theek hone par bhi health poori nahi hogi.

Bilkul, aapne samjhaya ki bimaar na hone par bhi mann aur rishton ki dikkat se health poori nahi hoti. Rohan ke case mein, board par likhe pareshaan aur akela hone se uski health ke kaunse do hisse prabhavit honge?
